content: Design systems bind all surfaces and interactive primitives to semantic tokens (--surface-canvas, --surface-elevated, --ink-primary, --border-focus) before component specs are emitted.
WCAG 2.1 AA requires >= 4.5:1 contrast for body copy, >= 3.0:1 for large text and interactive UI borders, visible focus-visible indicators, and reduced-motion parity.
Every wireframe specification defines explicit loading, empty, populated, and recoverable error states plus responsive desktop/tablet/mobile geometry.
CortexOS-native interfaces preserve Agent Dock + MainBrain + Terminal Sandbox + Summonable Workspace flows without multi-page SaaS navigation sidebars.
